name: autoexec_type_authority
label: Automation Classification Permission Table
description: The automated classification permission table is designed for use in association queries related to automation.

fields.name: type_id
fields.description: Tool type ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Operation type, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Permission type, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_uuid
fields.description: Permission UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the type_id, auth_uuid, auth_type, action fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
